{{Quote|Oh, and, Vsin "Cannon" Starbomber, don't cheat. This is a fair, honest game 'tween fellow pirates|Po "Big Guns" Mc'annon|<ref name="SWG:NoW">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|Notice of Warning}}</ref>}}
'''Vsin "Cannon" Starbomber''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:Ts" /> As the war escalated following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], as well as neutral groups, recruited a large number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. Vsin Starbomber and other fellow pirates, including [[Po Mc'annon]], organized a contest to shoot down and loot the new pilots.<ref name="SWG:NoW" /> At that time, Vsin "Cannon" Starbomber piloted a [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].<ref name="SWG:Ts" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempGenericPirate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Vsin "Cannon" Starbomber]]
Vsin Starbomber appeared appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Ts" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vsin "Cannon" Starbomber was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:Ts" />
